body.message:
Unfortunately, the property has been handed back to the owner, and as a result, we have had to cancel all existing bookings.

We sincerely apologize for the last-minute inconvenience this may have caused. We understand how disappointing this news is, and we truly appreciate your understanding. Thank you for your patience, and we hope to have the opportunity to host you at another one of our properties in the future.
